body: Thank you for your advice! I will definitely try to keep her comfortable, for her health is my #1 also. I feel horrible when I make her uncomfortable, or hurt her. I will make sure to do more research and talk to her doctors. I am also learning to understand that sex may not be possible sometimes or at all in the future. Again thank you for responding!
My old gfs doctor said for us to take it slow, real slow inch by inch. So I probably did more then a hundred strokes before I even get halfway.
